newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trading in Nordbanken suspended - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Nordbanken suspended - bourse.

text.p: Trading in Sweden's state-controlled bank Nordbanken was suspended on Wednesday morning at the bank's request with more information to be released later today, the Stockholm bourse said.
The Swedish government currently holds 65.5 percent of the bank and has previously indicated it is planning to sell its stake.
A Finance Ministry spokesman told Reuters on Wednesday that no decision had yet been made on the date of the sale.
Nordbanken said it would hold a press conference at 1130 GMT.
